name: The Jellyfish Observatory of the Deep
description: A giant, abandoned observatory dome rests on the ocean floor, its lens now housing a school of luminous jellyfish that pulse with bioluminescent light like a living galaxy.
prompt: A stunning and mysterious underwater scene. A large, ornate Victorian-style observatory dome lies on the seafloor, covered in coral and seaweed. The massive glass lens of the telescope is filled with dozens of translucent, glowing jellyfish in shades of blue, green, and violet. The jellyfish pulse gently with bioluminescent light, resembling a miniature galaxy swirling inside the lens. Around the observatory, more jellyfish float freely, casting ethereal glows on the sand and ruins. Sunlight filters down from above, creating dramatic light rays. The water is crystal clear, showing every detail. Hyper-realistic underwater digital art with volumetric lighting and particle effects.
caption: In the deepest dark, the stars still shine—guided by the gentle pulse of the sea. 🌌🪼
